blockers.finding: An uploaded canary attachment remains attached after temporary access expires or is revoked. Ordinary text sends then remain routed or blocked as invoice requests. Remove attachment / Clear tries a hosted clear requiring that inactive grant, and its catch does not clear local attachment state. The current mounted conversation cannot return to ordinary guidance without remount/reload.
sourceReproduction: Upload an approved original while the grant is active.
Expire/revoke the grant; expireCanaryAccess invalidates controls but preserves attachment and hostedReceivals.
Submit ordinary text: send sees the retained attachment and rejects at the elapsed deadline, or reaches a now-denied hosted invoice action.
Click attachment X/Clear: clear awaits a hosted attachment clear; authorization rejects; local reset is only in the success branch.
blockers.requiredCorrection: Provide a local-only detach/return-to-normal-conversation path after inactive access. Do not bypass source cleanup authorization or remove durable source/audit; preserve returned completed receipt IDs. The ordinary request must no longer carry the expired attachment.
blockers.verificationBasis: Read-only control-flow inspection; not a new browser test.
